codeSystems.name: MII_CS_Mikrobio_MRGN_Ergebnis
codeSystems.title: MII CS Microbiology MRGN Result
codeSystems.description: CodeSystem for results of the MRGN classification that cannot be represented with LOINC. The LOINC answer list LL6195-3 for 99780-9 contains only 2MRGN, 3MRGN and 4MRGN and therefore no negative value.

codeSystems.name: MII_CS_Mikrobio_Resistenzkategorie
codeSystems.title: MII CS Microbiology Resistance Category
codeSystems.description: Investigation codes (Observation.code) for assessing a detected pathogen with regard to a defined resistance category. Each code names the assessed category; the result of the assessment is in Observation.value.
codeSystems.ValueSet-mii-vs-mikrobio-resistenzkatego: MII VS Microbiology Resistance Category Status

codeSystems.name: MII_CS_Mikrobio_Susceptibility_NORM
codeSystems.title: MII CS Microbiology Susceptibility Norm
codeSystems.description: CodeSystem for coding the norms used to interpret the susceptibility of microorganisms to antimicrobial substances.
